acquirer: AltC Acquisition Corp.; its direct, wholly owned subsidiary AltC Merger Sub, Inc. will merge into Oklo Inc.
consideration_type: Stock: AltC Class A common stock at closing, plus a contingent right for eligible holders to receive additional AltC Class A common stock if specified price targets are met during the earnout period.
cash_consideration: No cash consideration to Oklo shareholders.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of Oklo Inc. common stock outstanding immediately before the effective time, after conversion of Oklo preferred stock and SAFEs, the holder receives shares of AltC Acquisition Corp. Class A common stock equal to the Exchange Ratio. The Exchange Ratio is the Per Share Equity Value, divided by $10.00 and rounded to the nearest 0.001; Per Share Equity Value is the sum of the Equity Value and the aggregate exercise price of all outstanding Oklo options, divided by Company Total Shares and rounded to the nearest $0.01. Equity Value is $850,000,000 plus net proceeds from any permitted pre-closing equity financing. Company Total Shares includes outstanding Oklo stock after the conversions and shares issuable upon exercise of all Oklo options immediately before the effective time, including applicable acceleration. No fractional AltC shares will be issued; each holder's aggregate entitlement is rounded to the nearest whole share, with 0.5 or more rounded up. Eligible holders also have a pro rata contingent right to up to 15,000,000 additional AltC Class A shares: 7,500,000 at the $12.00 trigger, 5,000,000 at the $14.00 trigger and 2,500,000 at the $16.00 trigger. Each trigger is based on the closing stock price for 20 trading days within a 60-consecutive-trading-day period during the earnout period, or qualifying change-in-control consideration; the share amounts and price targets are subject to the agreement's equitable-adjustment provisions.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted written waiver of applicable conditions: expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period; no governmental order, statute, rule or regulation enjoining or prohibiting the transactions; AltC having at least $5,000,001 in net tangible assets after shareholder redemptions; approval of the AltC stockholder matters and Oklo stockholder approval; required governance arrangements and post-closing board appointments; listing and continued-listing eligibility of the contemplated AltC shares, including earnout shares; and effectiveness of the registration statement without an SEC stop order or threatened or initiated action seeking one. Additional conditions to AltC's obligations include specified accuracy of Oklo's representations and warranties, material compliance with its covenants, no continuing Oklo Material Adverse Effect, delivery of an officer's certificate, and no NRC communication reasonably expected to materially adversely affect Oklo's ability to secure a Combined Construction and Operating License for the subject reactor. Additional conditions to Oklo's obligations include specified accuracy of AltC parties' representations and warranties, material compliance with their covenants, no continuing AltC Material Adverse Effect, Available Closing SPAC Cash of at least $250,000,000, delivery of an officer's certificate, and material performance of Sponsor Agreement covenants without specified threats concerning that agreement.
event_status: Announced; merger agreement signed and proposed transaction pending closing.
security_description: Oklo Inc. common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, including common shares issued upon the required pre-closing conversion of Oklo preferred stock and Simple Agreements for Future Equity. Excluded shares are cancelled without consideration; dissenting shares are subject to appraisal treatment. Oklo options are assumed and treated separately.
effective_date: Proposed merger: the effective time will be when the Certificate of Merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State on the closing date, or a later time agreed in writing by Oklo and AltC and specified in the filing. No calendar date is stated. Closing was expected in late 2023 or early 2024.
available_options: No holder election; eligible shares are exchanged for the specified stock consideration, subject to excluded-share and dissenting-share treatment.

cash_consideration: $25.00 per eligible Magellan common unit, subject to adjustments under the Merger Agreement. shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled virtual meetings on 9/21/2023: ONEOK shareholders vote on the stock issuance at 9:00 a.m. Central Time; Magellan unitholders vote on the Merger Agreement at 10:00 a.m. Central Time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction at closing, or waiver at or before closing where permitted: Magellan unitholder approval of the Merger Agreement; ONEOK shareholder approval of the stock issuance; NYSE approval of the ONEOK shares for listing, subject to official notice of issuance; no effective law or order prohibiting or making the merger or related transactions illegal; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period and any agreement with a governmental entity not to complete the transactions; and effectiveness of the Form S-4 without an SEC stop order or initiated or threatened stop-order proceedings. Magellan additionally requires the specified accuracy of ONEOK’s and Merger Sub’s representations and warranties, ONEOK’s material compliance with its pre-effective-time obligations, and a confirming officer certificate. The filing states that the HSR Act waiting period expired on 6/26/2023. Receipt or availability of financing is expressly not a closing condition.
event_status: Pending as of the 7/10/2023 amendment to the Form S-4 registration statement; the merger is proposed, subject to closing conditions, and not described as completed.
security_description: Magellan Midstream Partners, L.P. common units representing limited partner interests, excluding units owned immediately before the effective time by Magellan or its wholly owned subsidiaries or by ONEOK or its wholly owned subsidiaries; those excluded units will be canceled without consideration. Magellan phantom-unit awards have separate treatment.
effective_date: Not specified. The merger will become legally effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State on the closing date, or at a later date and time agreed by ONEOK and Magellan and specified in the certificate. The closing is scheduled for the second business day after the applicable conditions are satisfied or waived, unless the parties agree otherwise; the merger was expected to close in the third quarter of 2023.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible Magellan common unit automatically converts into the right to receive the stated cash-and-stock consideration.

acquirer: Regency Centers Corporation; its wholly owned subsidiary, Hercules Merger Sub, LLC, survives the second merger.
consideration_type: Stock; holders receive Regency Centers Corporation common stock. Cash is payable only in lieu of fractional shares.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share is stated. Cash, without interest, is payable only in lieu of a fractional Regency common share, equal to the fractional share multiplied by the volume-weighted average closing price of Regency common stock on the 10 consecutive trading days ending on the second business day before the closing date.
stock_exchange_ratio: 0.347 shares of Regency Centers Corporation common stock per 1 share of Urstadt Biddle Properties Inc. common stock, through the intermediate conversion into 1 share of UB Maryland I, Inc. common stock. The ratio is fixed except for specified adjustments, including REIT dividends and certain changes in outstanding shares. No fractional Regency common shares will be issued.
shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled Urstadt Biddle Properties Inc. stockholder special meeting: 8/16/2023 at 2:00 p.m., Eastern Time. No Regency Centers Corporation stockholder vote is required.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted, waiver of conditions: approval by Urstadt Biddle common and Class A common stockholders voting together as one class, representing a majority of all votes entitled to be cast; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective stop order or pending SEC stop-order proceeding; no legal restraint or law making the mergers illegal; Nasdaq listing approval for the Regency common and preferred shares to be issued; filing and acceptance of the articles classifying Regency Series A and Series B preferred stock; specified accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, and absence of a material adverse effect; officer certificates; and specified REIT-qualification and Section 368(a) reorganization tax opinions. Debt financing is not a closing condition.
event_status: Announced and pending as described in the proxy statement/prospectus dated 7/12/2023; the mergers remained subject to closing conditions.
security_description: Urstadt Biddle Properties Inc. common stock (UB common stock), traded on the NYSE under UBP. Shares are first converted into UB Maryland I, Inc. common stock, then exchanged in the second merger; specified shares held directly by Regency, Merger Sub or UB Maryland I are cancelled without consideration.
effective_date: No calendar date or time is specified. The first merger becomes effective at the date and time set forth in its articles of merger; the second merger becomes effective at the later date and time set forth in its articles of merger. The parties intend the second effective time to occur immediately, or as promptly as practicable, after the first, on the same date.
available_options: No holder election; the merger agreement specifies stock consideration, with cash only in lieu of fractional shares.

cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per share is stated. stock_exchange_ratio: 0.347 shares of Regency Centers Corporation common stock per 1 share of Urstadt Biddle Properties Inc. shareholder_vote_date: Scheduled Urstadt Biddle Properties Inc. stockholder special meeting: 8/16/2023 at 2:00 p.m., Eastern Time. No Regency Centers Corporation stockholder vote is required.

event_status: Announced and pending as described in the proxy statement/prospectus dated 7/12/2023; the mergers remained subject to closing conditions.

effective_date: No calendar date or time is specified. available_options: No holder election; the merger agreement specifies stock consideration, with cash only in lieu of fractional shares.

acquirer: OmniLit Acquisition Corp. (parent); its wholly owned subsidiary Optics Merger Sub Inc. will merge into Syntec Optics, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock, with a contingent right for Syntec Optics stockholders to receive up to 26,000,000 additional shares if specified post-closing stock-price thresholds are met.
cash_consideration: No cash distribution to Syntec Optics stockholders at closing. No cash amount per target share is stated.
stock_exchange_ratio: For each 1 share of Syntec Optics, Inc. common stock, the holder receives a number of OmniLit post-merger Class A common shares equal to the Exchange Ratio: (($325,000,000 minus Syntec Optics net debt immediately before closing) divided by $10.00) divided by the aggregate fully diluted Syntec Optics common shares. Fractional shares are rounded down to the nearest whole share for each holder.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, written waiver by the party benefiting from the condition: OmniLit and Syntec Optics stockholder approvals; effectiveness of the registration statement without an SEC stop order or unresolved proceedings to suspend effectiveness; expiration or termination of applicable HSR Act waiting periods; absence of a governmental restraint prohibiting the merger; OmniLit having at least $5,000,001 of net tangible assets immediately before or upon consummation; and Nasdaq approval of the post-merger Class A shares for listing, together with compliance with applicable continuing listing requirements and no uncured notice of non-compliance. OmniLit and Merger Sub also require the specified accuracy of Syntec Optics’ representations and warranties, material compliance with its pre-closing covenants, delivery of specified closing documents, and no Company Material Adverse Effect between signing and closing. Syntec Optics also requires the specified accuracy of OmniLit’s and Merger Sub’s representations and warranties, material compliance with OmniLit’s pre-closing covenants, the specified charter and bylaws amendments, and delivery of specified closing documents. Listing approval for the common stock and warrants is separately described as a non-waivable condition.
event_status: Pending as of the 7/12/2023 filing; the merger agreement was executed, but closing remained subject to conditions and OmniLit shareholder approval.
security_description: Issued and outstanding common stock of Syntec Optics, Inc., par value $0.01 per share, excluding treasury shares and shares held by stockholders who properly exercise appraisal rights.
effective_date: Not specified. The merger is to become legally effective when the Delaware Secretary of State accepts the merger certificate for filing on the closing date, or at a later time agreed in writing by OmniLit and Syntec Optics and specified in the certificate.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible Syntec Optics common share is converted into the right to receive the applicable stock consideration, subject to the separate treatment of treasury and dissenting shares.

acquirer: Diffusion Pharmaceuticals Inc. (parent); its wholly owned subsidiary, Dawn Merger Sub Inc., will merge with and into EIP Pharma, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock. Eligible EIP common shares convert into the right to receive Diffusion common stock at the exchange ratio. Cash is payable only in lieu of fractional Diffusion shares. Excluded and dissenting shares receive different treatment.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per EIP common share is stated. In lieu of a fractional Diffusion common share, a former EIP stockholder receives cash, without interest, equal to the fractional share multiplied by the volume-weighted average closing trading price of Diffusion common stock on Nasdaq for the ten consecutive trading days ending on the second trading day before the merger closing date.
stock_exchange_ratio: Estimated updated ratio: approximately 0.1659 pre-reverse-split shares of Diffusion common stock per 1 share of EIP common stock, after the June 2023 amendment establishing a $1.47-per-share conversion price for EIP convertible notes and the July 2023 EIP share issuance. If a reverse split occurs, the estimated ratio ranges from approximately 0.0207 post-split Diffusion shares per EIP common share at a 1-for-8 split to approximately 0.1106 at a 1-for-1.5 split. The final ratio is determined under the merger agreement formula, including adjustments for the parties’ capitalization, any reverse split and Diffusion’s net cash immediately before closing; it increases if Diffusion’s net cash is below $13.5 million and decreases if net cash exceeds $14.5 million. No fractional Diffusion shares will be issued.
shareholder_vote_date: Diffusion stockholders’ special meeting is scheduled for 8/15/2023 at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time to vote on the stock issuance and resulting change of control, and on the proposed reverse split. EIP stockholders will vote by written consent rather than at a meeting; no calendar date for those consents is stated. The merger agreement calls for EIP to obtain sufficient written consents no later than one business day after the Form S-4 registration statement becomes effective.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permissible waiver of the merger agreement’s conditions: required Diffusion stockholder approval of the stock issuance and, if applicable, reverse split; required EIP stockholder approval of the merger agreement, merger and related transactions; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without a stop order or threatened stop-order proceeding; continued Nasdaq listing of existing Diffusion shares and approval for listing of the merger shares and, if required, the initial listing application; and absence of an order prohibiting the merger or a law making it illegal. Party-specific conditions include the specified accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, delivery of required certificates and documents, and absence of a material adverse effect. EIP’s preferred stock and convertible notes must convert into EIP common stock; specified EIP investor agreements must terminate; applicable lock-up agreements must remain effective; and EIP must provide satisfactory evidence that its National Institute on Aging funding mechanism is in effect. Diffusion must have at least $12.0 million in net cash as calculated under the merger agreement, establish the agreed board composition and provide specified resignations. Required stockholder approvals, registration-statement effectiveness and absence of a prohibitory order or injunction cannot be waived; the other closing conditions may be waived by the applicable party.
event_status: Pending as of the filing; the merger agreement was signed on 3/30/2023, but closing remained subject to conditions. The EIP convertible notes were amended in June 2023 to establish a $1.47-per-share conversion price for the merger.
security_description: EIP Pharma, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, outstanding immediately before the merger effective time, including shares resulting from conversion of EIP Series A-1, Series A-2 and Series B preferred stock and EIP convertible notes. Certain excluded and dissenting shares are excepted. EIP options and warrants are assumed and adjusted separately rather than receiving this share consideration.
effective_date: No calendar date stated. The merger will become legally effective when the certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by Diffusion and EIP and specified in that certificate. Closing is to occur within three business days after the closing conditions are satisfied or waived.
available_options: No holder election; eligible EIP common shares convert into the right to receive Diffusion common stock under the exchange ratio, with cash only in lieu of fractional Diffusion shares. Properly dissenting holders may pursue statutory appraisal rights instead.

acquirer: Trident-Sun TopCo, Inc. (Parent), a wholly owned subsidiary of 3D Systems Corporation; Shemesh Printing Merger Company 2023 Ltd. is Parent’s merger subsidiary for this merger.
consideration_type: Elective consideration: eligible holders of Stratasys ordinary shares may elect mixed cash and stock, cash only, or stock only, subject to the agreement’s allocation and proration rules.
cash_consideration: Mixed election or no valid election: USD $7.50 per Stratasys ordinary share. Cash election: cash per share equal to USD $7.50 plus 1.5444 multiplied by the Parent Common Stock Reference Price, rounded to two decimal places, subject to proration if cash elections exceed the available cash election amount; prorated holders also receive stock. Stock election: generally no cash, but holders receive a prorated cash amount if the available cash election amount exceeds cash elections. Cash is paid instead of any fractional Parent share otherwise issuable, calculated using the closing price of 3D Systems common stock on the last trading day before the mergers become effective.
stock_exchange_ratio: Mixed election or no valid election: 1.5444 shares of Trident-Sun TopCo, Inc. common stock, par value $0.001 per share, per 1 Stratasys Ltd. ordinary share, nominal amount NIS 0.01. Stock election: 1.5444 plus USD $7.50 divided by the Parent Common Stock Reference Price, with the quotient rounded to four decimal places, shares of Parent common stock per 1 Stratasys ordinary share, subject to the stated proration rule if available cash exceeds cash elections. Prorated cash electors receive stock determined using the stock-election ratio and cash fraction. The reference price is the five-consecutive-trading-day volume-weighted average closing price of 3D Systems common stock on the NYSE ending on the second full trading day before closing, rounded to four decimal places. The consideration is subject to adjustment for the specified changes in outstanding shares before the effective times. No fractional Parent shares are issued; cash is paid instead.
closing_conditions: If the merger agreement becomes binding and effective under the Escrow Letter, closing is subject to satisfaction or waiver of conditions including approval by Stratasys shareholders and 3D Systems stockholders; NYSE listing authorization for Parent common stock; expiration or termination of the HSR Act waiting period and any agreement with the DOJ or FTC not to consummate the mergers; other required regulatory approvals or expiration of applicable waiting periods; effectiveness of the Form S-4 without a stop order or proceedings seeking one; absence of legal restraints or laws preventing or prohibiting the mergers; 50 days after filing the Stratasys merger proposal with the Israeli Companies Registrar and 30 days after approval by the shareholders of Stratasys and its merger subsidiary; the specified accuracy of representations and warranties, material compliance with covenants, and absence of a continuing material adverse effect for each company; and Parent’s receipt of the ISA Offering No-Action Letter. There is no condition concerning the parties’ ability to obtain financing.
event_status: Proposed; 3D Systems and its merger entities delivered executed signature pages in escrow, but Stratasys had not countersigned. The merger agreement was not yet binding or effective and required a qualifying termination of the Stratasys–Desktop Metal merger agreement followed by Stratasys’s execution and delivery of its signature page.
security_description: Stratasys Ltd. ordinary shares, nominal amount NIS 0.01 each, issued and outstanding immediately before the Stratasys merger effective time, excluding the specified treasury shares and shares held by 3D Systems, Parent, the merger subsidiaries, or a Stratasys subsidiary. Stratasys 102 Shares are not eligible to elect and are treated as stock-electing shares, with consideration deposited with the Stratasys 102 Trustee.
effective_date: Conditional: the Stratasys merger becomes effective when the Israeli Companies Registrar issues its certificate of merger. The parties intend to use reasonable best efforts for this to occur on the closing date, immediately after the 3D Systems merger becomes effective. No calendar date is stated.
available_options: Mixed election: USD $7.50 cash and 1.5444 Parent common shares per Stratasys ordinary share. Cash election: cash equal to USD $7.50 plus 1.5444 multiplied by the Parent Common Stock Reference Price per share, subject to proration into cash and stock if cash elections exceed available cash. Stock election: Parent common shares per share equal to 1.5444 plus USD $7.50 divided by the reference price, subject to proration into cash and stock if available cash exceeds cash elections. Aggregate cash and stock consideration does not vary with individual preferences. Stratasys 102 Shares cannot elect and are treated as stock-electing shares.
default_option: A Stratasys ordinary share with no valid election by the deadline is deemed a mixed-consideration electing share and receives USD $7.50 cash and 1.5444 Parent common shares, subject to the agreement’s terms. An election determined to be improperly made, revoked, or lost is ineffective and receives the same treatment.
election_deadline: 5:00 p.m. Eastern time on a date the parties agree is as near as practicable to three business days before closing, or another time or date mutually agreed in writing. The date is to be announced at least five business days beforehand. A waiver of the deadline must apply to all holders, be publicly disclosed on an agreed date, and have 3D Systems’ prior written consent.

acquirer: Patterson-UTI Energy, Inc.; its wholly owned subsidiaries Pecos Merger Sub Inc. and Pecos Second Merger Sub LLC carry out the first and second mergers, respectively.
consideration_type: Stock; cash is paid only in lieu of fractional shares. Eligible NexTier common shares, including restricted stock awards, receive the stated exchange ratio; excluded shares are cancelled without consideration.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per NexTier common share. Instead of issuing fractional Patterson-UTI common shares, holders receive U.S. dollar cash, without interest, equal to the fractional share interest multiplied by the average daily volume-weighted average price of Patterson-UTI common stock on Nasdaq for the ten consecutive trading days ending on the second full trading day before the closing date, rounded to the nearest cent.
stock_exchange_ratio: Fixed ratio of 0.7520 shares of Patterson-UTI Energy, Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, per 1 eligible share of NexTier Oilfield Solutions Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, including restricted stock awards. No fractional shares are issued; holders instead receive cash in lieu. The merger consideration is subject to equitable adjustment for specified changes in the companies’ shares or securities before the effective time.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or permitted waiver at or before closing: approval of NexTier’s merger proposal and Patterson-UTI’s stock issuance and charter amendment proposals; Nasdaq listing approval for the Patterson-UTI shares issuable under the agreement; expiration or termination of the applicable HSR Act waiting period and no written agreement with a governmental entity not to close; no law or governmental order prohibiting the mergers; and effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective stop order or pending or threatened SEC stop-order proceeding. Each party’s obligation also depends on the other party’s representations and warranties meeting the specified accuracy standards, material performance of its obligations, and receipt of an officer’s certificate. NexTier’s obligation additionally depends on Patterson-UTI taking the specified governance actions and NexTier receiving a closing-date legal opinion that the integrated mergers qualify as a reorganization under Section 368(a) of the Internal Revenue Code.
event_status: Pending; the merger agreement was signed on June 14, 2023, and the July 17, 2023 registration statement describes the mergers as proposed and subject to closing conditions. The filing refers to an amendment dated July [ ], 2023, without specifying its date.
security_description: Eligible shares of NexTier Oilfield Solutions Inc. common stock, par value $0.01 per share, issued and outstanding immediately before the effective time, including NexTier restricted stock awards. effective_date: Not specified. The first merger becomes effective at the time specified in its Delaware certificate of merger on the closing date; the second merger becomes effective one minute later. Closing is expected on the second business day after satisfaction or permitted waiver of the last applicable closing condition, unless the parties agree otherwise in writing.
available_options: No holder election; each eligible NexTier common share is converted automatically into the fixed stock consideration, with cash instead of any fractional share.

acquirer: Magenta Therapeutics, Inc. (parent); Dio Merger Sub, Inc., its wholly owned subsidiary, will merge into Dianthus Therapeutics, Inc.
consideration_type: Stock: each eligible share of Dianthus common stock, including common stock issued upon conversion of Dianthus preferred stock and in the Dianthus pre-closing financing, will convert into the right to receive Magenta common stock. Dissenting shares and shares canceled under the Merger Agreement are excluded.
cash_consideration: No regular cash consideration per Dianthus share is specified. No cash will be paid for a fractional share of Magenta common stock eliminated by rounding.
stock_exchange_ratio: Currently estimated at approximately 3.64 shares of Magenta common stock per 1 share of Dianthus common stock, before the proposed Magenta reverse stock split. The final exchange ratio is the Dianthus merger shares divided by Dianthus outstanding shares, rounded to eight decimal places, and is subject to adjustment based on Magenta’s net cash at closing and proceeds of the Dianthus pre-closing financing. Fractional Magenta shares will not be issued; each holder’s aggregate fractional entitlement will be rounded to the nearest whole share.
closing_conditions: Subject to satisfaction or, where permitted, waiver of the Merger Agreement’s conditions, including: Magenta stockholder approval of the Nasdaq stock issuance/change-of-control proposal and reverse stock split proposal; Dianthus stockholder approval by the specified common-stock, preferred-stock and Series A preferred-stock voting thresholds; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an outstanding stop order or proceeding seeking one, and compliance with applicable material state securities laws; absence of an effective legal restraint or law making the merger or related transactions illegal; Nasdaq approval to list the Magenta shares issued in the merger; and continued effectiveness of specified lock-up agreements. Each party’s additional conditions include the other party’s required representation and warranty accuracy, material covenant compliance, closing documents and absence of a material adverse effect. Magenta’s obligation also requires the Dianthus stockholder written consent and at least $70 million in proceeds from the Dianthus pre-closing financing received or receivable substantially simultaneously with closing. The filing states that Dianthus’ obligation is not conditioned on Magenta having a specified level of closing net cash.
event_status: Pending as of the July 17, 2023 filing. The merger agreement was signed on May 2, 2023; completion remained subject to stockholder approvals and other closing conditions.
security_description: Dianthus Therapeutics, Inc. common stock, including shares issued upon conversion of Dianthus preferred stock and shares issued in the Dianthus pre-closing financing; excludes shares canceled under the Merger Agreement and dissenting shares.
effective_date: No exact date or time specified. The merger will become effective when a certificate of merger is filed with the Delaware Secretary of State, or at a later time agreed by Magenta and Dianthus and specified in that certificate. The merger was anticipated to close in the third quarter of 2023, but the exact timing could not be predicted.
available_options: No holder election; eligible Dianthus common shares convert into the right to receive Magenta common stock under the Merger Agreement.

closing_conditions: The merger is subject to satisfaction or, where permitted by law, waiver of applicable conditions, including Arlington common shareholder approval; effectiveness of the Form S-4 registration statement without an effective SEC stop order or commenced stop-order proceeding; absence of a governmental restraint or law prohibiting the merger; applicable representations and warranties being sufficiently accurate; material compliance with covenants; delivery of specified certificates; receipt of opinions concerning each company’s REIT status and the merger’s qualification as a reorganization under Section 368(a) of the Code; absence of a material adverse effect on either company; NYSE listing approval for the EFC common, Series D preferred and Series E preferred shares to be issued, and filing and acceptance of the preferred-stock certificates of designations; and appointment of the Arlington director designee to EFC’s board effective at the merger’s effective time. Arlington preferred shareholders are not entitled to vote at the Arlington special meeting. EFC and Arlington stated that they were not aware of any material federal or state regulatory approvals required for the merger.
event_status: Pending as described in the July 18, 2023 preliminary proxy statement/prospectus; completion remains subject to closing conditions and is not guaranteed.
security_description: Arlington Asset Investment Corp. 8.250% Series C Fixed-to-Floating Rate Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock, par value $0.01 per share.
effective_date: Upon issuance of a certificate of merger by the State Corporation Commission of the Commonwealth of Virginia, or at a later time agreed in writing and specified in the articles of merger. Unless the parties otherwise agree in writing, the effective time is to occur on the closing date; no calendar date or clock time is stated.
available_options: No holder election; each Arlington Series C preferred share receives one EFC Series E preferred share.
